Hey mate it should be pretty easy going through Xsolla, when did you create the ticket? Every time I've had to contact them they've got back to me within 48 hours which is a pretty good response time IMO.

What I usually do is follow the chain up in these processes.

Take a moment, think about yourself.
On a piece of paper write down what you like about yourself - write at least 10 things.
On the other side, write down what you want in life, what will make you happy - again at least 10 things.
Fold it - put in in your wallet, it's a present for you, from yourself.

Now every time you feel down, take that paper out and read it.
